metadata.description: WhatsApp message-writing skills for Claude: give the context once, get the final message to paste.

plugins.name: whatsapp-skills
plugins.description: 8 skills that turn the context in your head into a ready-to-send WhatsApp message: 1:1 messages, replies, group and community announcements, invitations, promotions, status updates, channel posts, and a formatter that converts Markdown or email text into WhatsApp formatting. Draft-only: nothing is sent for you.
